name: Cat Skull Momentum (Combat)
body:
When the enemy gets careless, the enemy gets extinct.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, BAB +5, Cat Skull Combat, Cat Skull Repulsion, Improved Unarmed Strike

Benefits: When using this style, if you hit a flatfooted creature in the previous round, you gain a +4 bonus to confirm critical hits against that creature. This stacks with Critical Focus.

Special: This style’s benefit applies to light weapons, natural weapons, and one-handed weapons.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
